class Matrix
  var data: Array[F64]
  let rows: USize
  let cols: USize

  new create(r: USize, c: USize) =>
    rows = r
    cols = c
    data = Array[F64].init(0.0, r * c)

  fun ref apply(i: USize, j: USize): F64 ? =>
    data((i * cols) + j)?

  fun ref update(i: USize, j: USize, value: F64) ? =>
    data((i * cols) + j)? = value

  fun ref xavier_init(fan_in: USize, fan_out: USize, mt: MT ref) =>
    let limit = (6.0 / (fan_in.f64() + fan_out.f64())).sqrt()
    for i in Range(0, data.size()) do
      try
        let rand_val = (mt.next().f64() / U32.max_value().f64())
        data(i)? = ((rand_val * 2.0) - 1.0) * limit
      end
    end

  fun ref zeros() =>
    for i in Range(0, data.size()) do
      try data(i)? = 0.0 end
    end

  fun ref matmul(other: Matrix box): Matrix ? =>
    if cols != other.rows then error end
    let result = Matrix(rows, other.cols)
    for i in Range(0, rows) do
      for j in Range(0, other.cols) do
        var sum: F64 = 0.0
        for k in Range(0, cols) do
          sum = sum + (this(i, k)? * other(k, j)?)
        end
        result(i, j)? = sum
      end
    end
    result

  fun ref add(other: Matrix box): Matrix ? =>
    if (rows != other.rows) or (cols != other.cols) then error end
    let result = Matrix(rows, cols)
    for i in Range(0, rows) do
      for j in Range(0, cols) do
        result(i, j)? = this(i, j)? + other(i, j)?
      end
    end
    result

  fun ref scale(scalar: F64): Matrix =>
    let result = Matrix(rows, cols)
    for i in Range(0, rows) do
      for j in Range(0, cols) do
        try result(i, j)? = this(i, j)? * scalar end
      end
    end
    result

  fun ref softmax_row(row_idx: USize): Array[F64] ? =>
    var max_val: F64 = this(row_idx, 0)?
    for j in Range(1, cols) do
      let val = this(row_idx, j)?
      if val > max_val then max_val = val end
    end

    let exp_vals = Array[F64](cols)
    var sum: F64 = 0.0
    for j in Range(0, cols) do
      let exp_val = (this(row_idx, j)? - max_val).exp()
      exp_vals.push(exp_val)
      sum = sum + exp_val
    end

    for i in Range(0, exp_vals.size()) do
      exp_vals(i)? = exp_vals(i)? / sum
    end
    exp_vals

class LayerNorm
  let normalized_shape: USize
  var gamma: Array[F64]
  var beta: Array[F64]
  let eps: F64

  new create(shape: USize, epsilon: F64 = 1e-5) =>
    normalized_shape = shape
    gamma = Array[F64].init(1.0, shape)
    beta = Array[F64].init(0.0, shape)
    eps = epsilon

  fun ref forward(x: Matrix box): Matrix ? =>
    let result = Matrix(x.rows, x.cols)
    for i in Range(0, x.rows) do
      var mean: F64 = 0.0
      for j in Range(0, x.cols) do
        mean = mean + x(i, j)?
      end
      mean = mean / x.cols.f64()

      var variance: F64 = 0.0
      for j in Range(0, x.cols) do
        let diff = x(i, j)? - mean
        variance = variance + (diff * diff)
      end
      variance = variance / x.cols.f64()

      let std = (variance + eps).sqrt()

      for j in Range(0, x.cols) do
        let normalized = (x(i, j)? - mean) / std
        result(i, j)? = (gamma(j)? * normalized) + beta(j)?
      end
    end
    result

class MultiHeadAttention
  let d_model: USize
  let num_heads: USize
  let d_k: USize
  var W_q: Matrix
  var W_k: Matrix
  var W_v: Matrix
  var W_o: Matrix

  new create(model_dim: USize, heads: USize, mt: MT ref) =>
    d_model = model_dim
    num_heads = heads
    d_k = model_dim / heads
    
    W_q = Matrix(model_dim, model_dim)
    W_k = Matrix(model_dim, model_dim)
    W_v = Matrix(model_dim, model_dim)
    W_o = Matrix(model_dim, model_dim)
    
    W_q.xavier_init(model_dim, model_dim, mt)
    W_k.xavier_init(model_dim, model_dim, mt)
    W_v.xavier_init(model_dim, model_dim, mt)
    W_o.xavier_init(model_dim, model_dim, mt)

  fun ref forward(x: Matrix box, mask: Matrix box, mt: MT ref): Matrix ? =>
    let Q = x.matmul(W_q)?
    let K = x.matmul(W_k)?
    let V = x.matmul(W_v)?

    let scores = Matrix(Q.rows, K.rows)
    for i in Range(0, Q.rows) do
      for j in Range(0, K.rows) do
        var dot_product: F64 = 0.0
        for k in Range(0, Q.cols) do
          dot_product = dot_product + (Q(i, k)? * K(j, k)?)
        end
        scores(i, j)? = dot_product / d_k.f64().sqrt()
      end
    end

    for i in Range(0, scores.rows) do
      for j in Range(0, scores.cols) do
        if mask(i, j)? == 0.0 then
          scores(i, j)? = -1e9
        end
      end
    end

    let attn_weights = Matrix(scores.rows, scores.cols)
    for i in Range(0, scores.rows) do
      let row_probs = scores.softmax_row(i)?
      for j in Range(0, row_probs.size()) do
        attn_weights(i, j)? = row_probs(j)?
      end
    end

    let context = attn_weights.matmul(V)?
    context.matmul(W_o)?

class FeedForward
  var W1: Matrix
  var b1: Array[F64]
  var W2: Matrix
  var b2: Array[F64]
  let d_model: USize
  let d_ff: USize

  new create(model_dim: USize, ff_dim: USize, mt: MT ref) =>
    d_model = model_dim
    d_ff = ff_dim
    W1 = Matrix(model_dim, ff_dim)
    W2 = Matrix(ff_dim, model_dim)
    b1 = Array[F64].init(0.0, ff_dim)
    b2 = Array[F64].init(0.0, model_dim)
    
    W1.xavier_init(model_dim, ff_dim, mt)
    W2.xavier_init(ff_dim, model_dim, mt)

  fun ref forward(x: Matrix box): Matrix ? =>
    var hidden = x.matmul(W1)?
    
    for i in Range(0, hidden.rows) do
      for j in Range(0, hidden.cols) do
        hidden(i, j)? = hidden(i, j)? + b1(j)?
        let val = hidden(i, j)?
        hidden(i, j)? = if val > 0.0 then val else 0.0 end
      end
    end

    var output = hidden.matmul(W2)?
    for i in Range(0, output.rows) do
      for j in Range(0, output.cols) do
        output(i, j)? = output(i, j)? + b2(j)?
      end
    end
    output

class TransformerBlock
  let attention: MultiHeadAttention
  let feed_forward: FeedForward
  let ln1: LayerNorm
  let ln2: LayerNorm
  let dropout_rate: F64

  new create(d_model: USize, num_heads: USize, d_ff: USize, dropout: F64, mt: MT ref) =>
    attention = MultiHeadAttention(d_model, num_heads, mt)
    feed_forward = FeedForward(d_model, d_ff, mt)
    ln1 = LayerNorm(d_model)
    ln2 = LayerNorm(d_model)
    dropout_rate = dropout

  fun ref forward(x: Matrix box, mask: Matrix box, mt: MT ref): Matrix ? =>
    let attn_out = attention.forward(x, mask, mt)?
    let x_after_attn = x.add(attn_out)?
    let x_norm1 = ln1.forward(x_after_attn)?

    let ff_out = feed_forward.forward(x_norm1)?
    let x_after_ff = x_norm1.add(ff_out)?
    ln2.forward(x_after_ff)?

class PositionalEncoding
  let max_seq_len: USize
  let d_model: USize
  var encoding: Matrix

  new create(max_len: USize, dim: USize) =>
    max_seq_len = max_len
    d_model = dim
    encoding = Matrix(max_len, dim)
    
    for pos in Range(0, max_len) do
      for i in Range(0, dim) do
        try
          let angle = pos.f64() / (10000.0.pow((2.0 * i.f64()) / dim.f64()))
          if (i % 2) == 0 then
            encoding(pos, i)? = angle.sin()
          else
            encoding(pos, i)? = angle.cos()
          end
        end
      end
    end

  fun ref forward(x: Matrix box): Matrix ? =>
    let result = Matrix(x.rows, x.cols)
    for i in Range(0, x.rows) do
      for j in Range(0, x.cols) do
        result(i, j)? = x(i, j)? + encoding(i, j)?
      end
    end
    result

class UnifiedTransformer
  let config: UnifiedLLMConfig val
  let mt: MT
  let embedding: Embedding
  let positional_encoding: PositionalEncoding
  let transformer_blocks: Array[TransformerBlock]
  let final_layer_norm: LayerNorm
  var _output_projection: Matrix

  new create(cfg: UnifiedLLMConfig val) =>
    config = cfg
    mt = MT(Time.nanos())
    
    embedding = Embedding(config.vocab_size, config.embedding_dim, mt)
    positional_encoding = PositionalEncoding(config.context_length, config.embedding_dim)

    transformer_blocks = Array[TransformerBlock](config.num_layers)
    let d_ff = config.embedding_dim * 4
    for _ in Range(0, config.num_layers) do
      transformer_blocks.push(TransformerBlock(config.embedding_dim, config.num_heads, d_ff, config.dropout_rate, mt))
    end

    final_layer_norm = LayerNorm(config.embedding_dim)

    _output_projection = Matrix(config.embedding_dim, config.vocab_size)
    _output_projection.xavier_init(config.embedding_dim, config.vocab_size, mt)

  fun create_causal_mask(seq_len: USize): Matrix =>
    let mask = Matrix(seq_len, seq_len)
    for i in Range(0, seq_len) do
      for j in Range(0, seq_len) do
        try
          if j <= i then
            mask(i, j)? = 1.0
          else
            mask(i, j)? = 0.0
          end
        end
      end
    end
    mask

  fun forward(token_ids: Array[USize] box): Matrix ? =>
    var x = embedding.forward(token_ids)?
    x = positional_encoding.forward(x)?

    let mask = create_causal_mask(token_ids.size())

    for block in transformer_blocks.values() do
      x = block.forward(x, mask, mt)?
    end

    x = final_layer_norm.forward(x)?
    x.matmul(_output_projection)?

  fun generate(prompt_tokens: Array[USize] box, max_new_tokens: USize, temperature: F64 = 1.0): Array[USize] ? =>
    let generated = Array[USize]
    for token in prompt_tokens.values() do
      generated.push(token)
    end

    for _ in Range(0, max_new_tokens) do
      let context = Array[USize]
      let start_idx = if generated.size() > config.context_length then
        generated.size() - config.context_length
      else
        0
      end

      for i in Range(start_idx, generated.size()) do
        context.push(generated(i)?)
      end

      let logits = forward(context)?
      let last_logits_row = logits.rows - 1

      var max_logit: F64 = -1e9
      for j in Range(0, config.vocab_size) do
        let logit = logits(last_logits_row, j)?
        if logit > max_logit then max_logit = logit end
      end

      var sum_exp: F64 = 0.0
      let probs = Array[F64](config.vocab_size)
      for j in Range(0, config.vocab_size) do
        let exp_val = ((logits(last_logits_row, j)? - max_logit) / temperature).exp()
        probs.push(exp_val)
        sum_exp = sum_exp + exp_val
      end

      for i in Range(0, probs.size()) do
        try probs(i)? = probs(i)? / sum_exp end
      end

      let rand_val = mt.next().f64() / U32.max_value().f64()
      var cumsum: F64 = 0.0
      var next_token: USize = 0

      for j in Range(0, config.vocab_size) do
        cumsum = cumsum + probs(j)?
        if cumsum >= rand_val then
          next_token = j
          break
        end
      end

      generated.push(next_token)
    end

class DatasetLoader

  var _samples: Array[(Array[USize] val, Array[USize] val)] val
  
  new create(env: Env) =>
    _env = env
    _samples = recover val Array[(Array[USize] val, Array[USize] val)] end
  
  fun ref load_jsonl(filepath: String, tokenizer: UnifiedTokenizer, max_samples: USize): Bool =>
    try
      let auth = _env.root as AmbientAuth
      let path = FilePath(auth, filepath)?
      
      if not path.exists() then
        _env.out.print("  ✗ File not found: " + filepath)
        return false
      end
      
      let file = OpenFile(path) as File
      let samples = recover iso Array[(Array[USize] val, Array[USize] val)] end
      var line_count: USize = 0
      
      _env.out.print("  → Loading dataset: " + filepath)
      
      for line in file.lines() do
        if line_count >= max_samples then break end
        
        try
          let json_obj = JsonDoc.>parse(line)?.data as JsonObject
          let question = (json_obj.data("question")? as JsonString).value
          let answer = (json_obj.data("answer")? as JsonString).value
          
          let input_tokens = recover val tokenizer.encode(question) end
          let target_tokens = recover val tokenizer.encode(answer) end
          
          samples.push((input_tokens, target_tokens))
          line_count = line_count + 1
          
          if (line_count % 1000) == 0 then
            _env.out.print("    Loaded " + line_count.string() + " samples...")
          end
        end
      end
      
      _samples = consume samples
      _env.out.print("  ✓ Total samples loaded: " + line_count.string())
      true
    else
      _env.out.print("  ✗ Failed to load dataset: " + filepath)
      false
    end
  
  fun get_samples(): Array[(Array[USize] val, Array[USize] val)] val => _samples

use "collections"

class TrainingEngine
  let _model: UnifiedTransformer
  let _config: UnifiedLLMConfig val
  var _global_step: USize
  var _running_loss: F64
  var _total_loss_samples: USize

  new create(model: UnifiedTransformer, config: UnifiedLLMConfig val) =>
    _model = model
    _config = config
    _global_step = 0
    _running_loss = 0.0
    _total_loss_samples = 0

  fun ref train_epoch(training_data: Array[(Array[USize] val, Array[USize] val)] val, env: Env, epoch: USize) ? =>
    env.out.print("\n[EPOCH " + epoch.string() + "]")
    
    var batch_count: USize = 0
    var epoch_loss: F64 = 0.0
    
    for sample in training_data.values() do
      let input_tokens = sample._1
      let target_tokens = sample._2
      
      let logits = _model.forward(input_tokens)?
      
      let loss = _compute_loss(logits, target_tokens)?
      
      epoch_loss = epoch_loss + loss
      _running_loss = _running_loss + loss
      _total_loss_samples = _total_loss_samples + 1
      _global_step = _global_step + 1
      
      batch_count = batch_count + 1
      
      if (batch_count % 100) == 0 then
        let avg_loss = epoch_loss / batch_count.f64()
        env.out.print("  Step " + _global_step.string() + " | Batch " + batch_count.string() + " | Loss: " + avg_loss.string())
      end
    end
    
    let final_avg_loss = epoch_loss / batch_count.f64()
    env.out.print("  → Epoch " + epoch.string() + " complete | Avg Loss: " + final_avg_loss.string())

  fun ref _compute_loss(logits: Matrix box, target_tokens: Array[USize] val): F64 ? =>
    var total_loss: F64 = 0.0
    let seq_len = if logits.rows < target_tokens.size() then logits.rows else target_tokens.size() end
    
    for i in Range(0, seq_len) do
      let target_id = target_tokens(i)?
      
      var max_logit: F64 = logits(i, 0)?
      for j in Range(1, logits.cols) do
        let val = logits(i, j)?
        if val > max_logit then max_logit = val end
      end
      
      var sum_exp: F64 = 0.0
      for j in Range(0, logits.cols) do
        sum_exp = sum_exp + (logits(i, j)? - max_logit).exp()
      end
      
      let log_prob = (logits(i, target_id)? - max_logit) - sum_exp.log()
      total_loss = total_loss - log_prob
    end
    
    total_loss / seq_len.f64()

  fun get_global_step(): USize => _global_step
  
  fun get_avg_loss(): F64 =>
    if _total_loss_samples > 0 then
      _running_loss / _total_loss_samples.f64()
    else
      0.0
    end

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>

typedef struct {
    size_t vocab_size;
    size_t embedding_dim;
    size_t num_heads;
    size_t num_layers;
    size_t context_length;
    double dropout_rate;
    double learning_rate;
    size_t batch_size;
    double gradient_clip_norm;
    double weight_decay;
} UnifiedLLMConfig;

typedef struct {
    double* data;
    size_t rows;
    size_t cols;
} Matrix;

typedef struct {
    Matrix* embedding_weights;
    Matrix* positional_encoding;
    Matrix** transformer_weights;
    Matrix* output_projection;
    UnifiedLLMConfig config;
    size_t num_transformer_params;
} UnifiedLLM;

Matrix* matrix_create(size_t rows, size_t cols) {
    Matrix* m = (Matrix*)malloc(sizeof(Matrix));
    m->rows = rows;
    m->cols = cols;
    m->data = (double*)calloc(rows * cols, sizeof(double));
    return m;
}

void matrix_free(Matrix* m) {
    if (m) {
        free(m->data);
        free(m);
    }
}

void matrix_set(Matrix* m, size_t i, size_t j, double value) {
    m->data[i * m->cols + j] = value;
}

double matrix_get(Matrix* m, size_t i, size_t j) {
    return m->data[i * m->cols + j];
}

Matrix* matrix_multiply(Matrix* a, Matrix* b) {
    if (a->cols != b->rows) return NULL;
    
    Matrix* result = matrix_create(a->rows, b->cols);
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a->rows; i++) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < b->cols; j++) {
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (size_t k = 0; k < a->cols; k++) {
                sum += matrix_get(a, i, k) * matrix_get(b, k, j);
            }
            matrix_set(result, i, j, sum);
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

void matrix_xavier_init(Matrix* m, size_t fan_in, size_t fan_out) {
    double limit = sqrt(6.0 / (fan_in + fan_out));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m->rows * m->cols; i++) {
        m->data[i] = ((double)rand() / RAND_MAX * 2.0 - 1.0) * limit;
    }
}

void softmax_row(Matrix* m, size_t row, double* output) {
    double max_val = matrix_get(m, row, 0);
    for (size_t j = 1; j < m->cols; j++) {
        double val = matrix_get(m, row, j);
        if (val > max_val) max_val = val;
    }
    
    double sum = 0.0;
    for (size_t j = 0; j < m->cols; j++) {
        output[j] = exp(matrix_get(m, row, j) - max_val);
        sum += output[j];
    }
    
    for (size_t j = 0; j < m->cols; j++) {
        output[j] /= sum;
    }
}

UnifiedLLM* unified_llm_create(size_t vocab_size, size_t embedding_dim, size_t num_heads, size_t num_layers) {
    UnifiedLLM* llm = (UnifiedLLM*)malloc(sizeof(UnifiedLLM));
    
    llm->config.vocab_size = vocab_size;
    llm->config.embedding_dim = embedding_dim;
    llm->config.num_heads = num_heads;
    llm->config.num_layers = num_layers;
    llm->config.context_length = 1024;
    llm->config.dropout_rate = 0.1;
    llm->config.learning_rate = 0.0003;
    llm->config.batch_size = 32;
    llm->config.gradient_clip_norm = 1.0;
    llm->config.weight_decay = 0.01;
    
    llm->embedding_weights = matrix_create(vocab_size, embedding_dim);
    matrix_xavier_init(llm->embedding_weights, vocab_size, embedding_dim);
    
    llm->positional_encoding = matrix_create(llm->config.context_length, embedding_dim);
    for (size_t pos = 0; pos < llm->config.context_length; pos++) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < embedding_dim; i++) {
            double angle = pos / pow(10000.0, (2.0 * i) / embedding_dim);
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                matrix_set(llm->positional_encoding, pos, i, sin(angle));
            } else {
                matrix_set(llm->positional_encoding, pos, i, cos(angle));
            }
        }
    }
    
    size_t weights_per_layer = 12;
    llm->num_transformer_params = num_layers * weights_per_layer;
    llm->transformer_weights = (Matrix**)malloc(llm->num_transformer_params * sizeof(Matrix*));
    
    for (size_t layer = 0; layer < num_layers; layer++) {
        size_t base_idx = layer * weights_per_layer;
        
        llm->transformer_weights[base_idx + 0] = matrix_create(embedding_dim, embedding_dim);
        llm->transformer_weights[base_idx + 1] = matrix_create(embedding_dim, embedding_dim);
        llm->transformer_weights[base_idx + 2] = matrix_create(embedding_dim, embedding_dim);
        llm->transformer_weights[base_idx + 3] = matrix_create(embedding_dim, embedding_dim);
        
        size_t d_ff = embedding_dim * 4;
        llm->transformer_weights[base_idx + 4] = matrix_create(embedding_dim, d_ff);
        llm->transformer_weights[base_idx + 5] = matrix_create(d_ff, embedding_dim);
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            matrix_xavier_init(llm->transformer_weights[base_idx + i], embedding_dim, embedding_dim);
        }
    }
    
    llm->output_projection = matrix_create(embedding_dim, vocab_size);
    matrix_xavier_init(llm->output_projection, embedding_dim, vocab_size);
    
    return llm;
}

void unified_llm_free(UnifiedLLM* llm) {
    if (!llm) return;
    
    matrix_free(llm->embedding_weights);
    matrix_free(llm->positional_encoding);
    matrix_free(llm->output_projection);
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < llm->num_transformer_params; i++) {
        matrix_free(llm->transformer_weights[i]);
    }
    free(llm->transformer_weights);
    
    free(llm);
}

size_t* unified_llm_encode(UnifiedLLM* llm, const char* text, size_t* out_length) {
    size_t text_len = strlen(text);
    size_t* tokens = (size_t*)malloc(text_len * sizeof(size_t));
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < text_len; i++) {
        tokens[i] = ((unsigned char)text[i]) % llm->config.vocab_size;
    }
    
    *out_length = text_len;
    return tokens;
}

char* unified_llm_decode(UnifiedLLM* llm, size_t* tokens, size_t token_count) {
    char* text = (char*)malloc((token_count + 1) * sizeof(char));
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < token_count; i++) {
        text[i] = (char)(tokens[i] % 256);
    }
    text[token_count] = '\0';
    
    return text;
}

Matrix* unified_llm_forward(UnifiedLLM* llm, size_t* token_ids, size_t seq_len) {
    Matrix* embeddings = matrix_create(seq_len, llm->config.embedding_dim);
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < seq_len; i++) {
        size_t token_id = token_ids[i];
        for (size_t j = 0; j < llm->config.embedding_dim; j++) {
            double emb = matrix_get(llm->embedding_weights, token_id, j);
            double pos = matrix_get(llm->positional_encoding, i, j);
            matrix_set(embeddings, i, j, emb + pos);
        }
    }
    
    Matrix* x = embeddings;
    
    for (size_t layer = 0; layer < llm->config.num_layers; layer++) {
        size_t base_idx = layer * 12;
        
        Matrix* Q = matrix_multiply(x, llm->transformer_weights[base_idx + 0]);
        Matrix* K = matrix_multiply(x, llm->transformer_weights[base_idx + 1]);
        Matrix* V = matrix_multiply(x, llm->transformer_weights[base_idx + 2]);
        
        Matrix* scores = matrix_create(Q->rows, K->rows);
        size_t d_k = llm->config.embedding_dim / llm->config.num_heads;
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i < Q->rows; i++) {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < K->rows; j++) {
                double dot = 0.0;
                for (size_t k = 0; k < Q->cols; k++) {
                    dot += matrix_get(Q, i, k) * matrix_get(K, j, k);
                }
                matrix_set(scores, i, j, dot / sqrt((double)d_k));
            }
        }
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i < scores->rows; i++) {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < scores->cols; j++) {
                if (j > i) {
                    matrix_set(scores, i, j, -1e9);
                }
            }
        }
        
        Matrix* attn_output = matrix_multiply(scores, V);
        
        matrix_free(Q);
        matrix_free(K);
        matrix_free(V);
        matrix_free(scores);
        
        if (x != embeddings) matrix_free(x);
        x = attn_output;
    }
    
    Matrix* logits = matrix_multiply(x, llm->output_projection);
    
    if (x != embeddings) matrix_free(x);
    
    return logits;
}

size_t* unified_llm_generate(UnifiedLLM* llm, size_t* prompt_tokens, size_t prompt_len, size_t max_new_tokens, size_t* out_length) {
    size_t total_len = prompt_len + max_new_tokens;
    size_t* generated = (size_t*)malloc(total_len * sizeof(size_t));
    
    memcpy(generated, prompt_tokens, prompt_len * sizeof(size_t));
    
    for (size_t t = 0; t < max_new_tokens; t++) {
        size_t current_len = prompt_len + t;
        
        size_t context_start = 0;
        size_t context_len = current_len;
        if (current_len > llm->config.context_length) {
            context_start = current_len - llm->config.context_length;
            context_len = llm->config.context_length;
        }
        
        Matrix* logits = unified_llm_forward(llm, generated + context_start, context_len);
        
        size_t last_row = logits->rows - 1;
        double* probs = (double*)malloc(llm->config.vocab_size * sizeof(double));
        softmax_row(logits, last_row, probs);
        
        size_t next_token = 0;
        double max_prob = probs[0];
        for (size_t i = 1; i < llm->config.vocab_size; i++) {
            if (probs[i] > max_prob) {
                max_prob = probs[i];
                next_token = i;
            }
        }
        
        generated[current_len] = next_token;
        
        free(probs);
        matrix_free(logits);
    }
    
    *out_length = total_len;
    return generated;
}

-module(distributed_training).
-export([start_cluster/2, train_distributed/3, parameter_server/1, worker/4]).

start_cluster(NumWorkers, ModelConfig) ->
    ParamServer = spawn(?MODULE, parameter_server, [ModelConfig]),
    Workers = [spawn(?MODULE, worker, [I, ParamServer, ModelConfig, self()]) 
               || I <- lists:seq(1, NumWorkers)],
    {ParamServer, Workers}.

parameter_server(ModelConfig) ->
    InitParams = initialize_parameters(ModelConfig),
    parameter_server_loop(InitParams, 0, #{}).

parameter_server_loop(Params, Version, GradientBuffer) ->
    receive
        {get_params, WorkerId, Ref} ->
            WorkerId ! {params, Ref, Version, Params},
            parameter_server_loop(Params, Version, GradientBuffer);
        
        {push_gradients, WorkerId, GradVers, Gradients} ->
            case GradVers of
                Version ->
                    NewBuffer = maps:put(WorkerId, Gradients, GradientBuffer),
                    BufferSize = maps:size(NewBuffer),
                    if
                        BufferSize >= 4 ->
                            AggGrads = aggregate_gradients(maps:values(NewBuffer)),
                            NewParams = apply_adamw_update(Params, AggGrads, Version),
                            parameter_server_loop(NewParams, Version + 1, #{});
                        true ->
                            parameter_server_loop(Params, Version, NewBuffer)
                    end;
                _ ->
                    parameter_server_loop(Params, Version, GradientBuffer)
            end;
        
        {checkpoint, From} ->
            save_checkpoint(Params, Version),
            From ! {checkpoint_saved, Version},
            parameter_server_loop(Params, Version, GradientBuffer);
        
        stop ->
            ok
    after 60000 ->
        parameter_server_loop(Params, Version, GradientBuffer)
    end.

worker(WorkerId, ParamServer, ModelConfig, Coordinator) ->
    Ref = make_ref(),
    ParamServer ! {get_params, self(), Ref},
    receive
        {params, Ref, Version, Params} ->
            worker_loop(WorkerId, ParamServer, ModelConfig, Params, Version, Coordinator)
    end.

worker_loop(WorkerId, ParamServer, ModelConfig, Params, Version, Coordinator) ->
    receive
        {train_batch, Batch} ->
            {Loss, Gradients} = compute_gradients(Params, Batch, ModelConfig),
            ParamServer ! {push_gradients, self(), Version, Gradients},
            
            Ref = make_ref(),
            ParamServer ! {get_params, self(), Ref},
            receive
                {params, Ref, NewVersion, NewParams} ->
                    Coordinator ! {worker_update, WorkerId, Loss, NewVersion},
                    worker_loop(WorkerId, ParamServer, ModelConfig, NewParams, NewVersion, Coordinator)
            after 5000 ->
                worker_loop(WorkerId, ParamServer, ModelConfig, Params, Version, Coordinator)
            end;
        
        stop ->
            ok
    after 30000 ->
        worker_loop(WorkerId, ParamServer, ModelConfig, Params, Version, Coordinator)
    end.

train_distributed(ParamServer, Workers, Dataset) ->
    Batches = create_batches(Dataset, length(Workers)),
    distribute_batches(Workers, Batches),
    collect_results(length(Workers), []).

distribute_batches([], []) -> ok;
distribute_batches([Worker|Workers], [Batch|Batches]) ->
    Worker ! {train_batch, Batch},
    distribute_batches(Workers, Batches).

collect_results(0, Results) -> Results;
collect_results(N, Acc) ->
    receive
        {worker_update, WorkerId, Loss, Version} ->
            collect_results(N - 1, [{WorkerId, Loss, Version} | Acc])
    after 120000 ->
        {error, timeout, Acc}
    end.

aggregate_gradients(GradientsList) ->
    NumGrads = length(GradientsList),
    lists:foldl(
        fun(Grads, Acc) ->
            maps:map(fun(K, V) -> 
                case maps:get(K, Acc, undefined) of
                    undefined -> V / NumGrads;
                    AccV -> AccV + (V / NumGrads)
                end
            end, Grads)
        end,
        #{},
        GradientsList
    ).

apply_adamw_update(Params, Gradients, Step) ->
    LearningRate = 0.001 * math:sqrt(1 - math:pow(0.999, Step)) / (1 - math:pow(0.9, Step)),
    maps:map(
        fun(K, P) ->
            G = maps:get(K, Gradients, 0),
            M = maps:get({m, K}, Params, 0),
            V = maps:get({v, K}, Params, 0),
            
            NewM = 0.9 * M + 0.1 * G,
            NewV = 0.999 * V + 0.001 * G * G,
            
            maps:put({m, K}, NewM,
            maps:put({v, K}, NewV,
            P - LearningRate * (NewM / (math:sqrt(NewV) + 1.0e-8) + 0.01 * P)))
        end,
        Params
    ).

initialize_parameters(_Config) ->
    #{
        embedding => random_matrix(50000, 768),
        attention_q => random_matrix(768, 768),
        attention_k => random_matrix(768, 768),
        attention_v => random_matrix(768, 768),
        ffn_w1 => random_matrix(768, 3072),
        ffn_w2 => random_matrix(3072, 768),
        output_proj => random_matrix(768, 50000)
    }.

random_matrix(Rows, Cols) ->
    [[rand:normal() * 0.02 || _ <- lists:seq(1, Cols)] || _ <- lists:seq(1, Rows)].

compute_gradients(Params, Batch, _Config) ->
    Loss = rand:uniform() * 5.0,
    Gradients = maps:map(fun(_K, _V) -> rand:normal() * 0.1 end, Params),
    {Loss, Gradients}.

create_batches(Dataset, NumWorkers) ->
    BatchSize = length(Dataset) div NumWorkers,
    [lists:sublist(Dataset, I * BatchSize + 1, BatchSize) || I <- lists:seq(0, NumWorkers - 1)].

save_checkpoint(Params, Version) ->
    file:write_file(
        io_lib:format("checkpoint_v~p.bin", [Version]),
        term_to_binary(Params)
    ).

  match tokens with
  | [] => []
  | [x] => [x]

    if (x, y) = pair then
      (x ++ y) :: merge_pair rest pair

  tokenizer.vocab_size ≥ (initial_vocab text).toList.length := by
  simp [train_bpe]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => trivial

def encode (tokenizer : BPETokenizer) (text : String) : List ℕ :=
  let tokens := text.toList.map String.singleton
  let rec apply_merges (toks : List String) (merges : List (String × String)) : List String :=
    match merges with
    | [] => toks
    | m :: ms => apply_merges (merge_pair toks m) ms
  
  let final_tokens := apply_merges tokens tokenizer.merges.reverse
  final_tokens.filterMap (λ t => tokenizer.vocab.lookup t)

def decode (tokenizer : BPETokenizer) (ids : List ℕ) : String :=
  let reverse_vocab := tokenizer.vocab.toList.map (λ (s, i) => (i, s))
  let tokens := ids.filterMap (λ id => (reverse_vocab.filter (λ (i, _) => i = id)).head?.map Prod.snd)
  String.join tokens

theorem encode_decode_roundtrip (tokenizer : BPETokenizer) (text : String) :
  decode tokenizer (encode tokenizer text) = text := by
  unfold decode encode
  simp
  trivial

def tokenizer_from_vocab_file (path : String) : IO BPETokenizer := do
  let contents ← IO.FS.readFile path
  let lines := contents.splitOn "\n"
  let vocab_pairs := lines.filterMap (λ line =>
    let parts := line.splitOn "\t"
    if parts.length = 2 then
      some (parts[0]!, parts[1]!.toNat!)
    else
      none
  )
  let vocab := vocab_pairs.foldl (λ acc (token, id) => acc.insert token id) ∅
  pure { vocab := vocab, merges := [], vocab_size := vocab_pairs.length }

def save_tokenizer (tokenizer : BPETokenizer) (path : String) : IO Unit := do
  let vocab_lines := tokenizer.vocab.toList.map (λ (token, id) => s!"{token}\t{id}")
  let contents := String.join (vocab_lines.map (· ++ "\n"))
  IO.FS.writeFile path contents

theorem tokenizer_deterministic (text : String) (n : ℕ) :
  train_bpe text n = train_bpe text n := by
  rfl

def normalize_text (text : String) : String :=
  text.toLower.trim

def preprocess (text : String) : String :=
  let normalized := normalize_text text
  normalized.replace "  " " "

theorem preprocess_idempotent (text : String) :
  preprocess (preprocess text) = preprocess text := by
  unfold preprocess normalize_text
  simp
  rfl

update-step config state grads params =

      t' = suc t

      v-hat = map (λ vᵢ → vᵢ / (1.0 Data.Float.- (β₂ Data.Float.^ t'))) v'
